queries.sql: DELETE FROM ppx_items AS i RETURNING i.*
DELETE FROM ppx_items RETURNING id, id
DELETE FROM ppx_items WHERE id = $1 RETURNING name
INSERT INTO ppx_items (id) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
INSERT INTO ppx_items (id, note) VALUES ($1, $2), ($3, DEFAULT)
INSERT INTO ppx_items (tenant, id, name) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
INSERT INTO ppx_items (tenant, id, name) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (tenant, id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name RETURNING id
INSERT INTO ppx_items AS i (id, name) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING i.id AS identifier, i.name

INSERT INTO ppx_items AS i (tenant, id, name) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (id, tenant) DO UPDATE SET name = $4, note = EXCLUDED.note, revision = DEFAULT WHERE i.id = $5 AND excluded.tenant = $6 RETURNING i.id
SELECT "P".name FROM public.join_people AS "P" JOIN public.join_links AS "L" ON "P".id = "L".person_id
SELECT * FROM ROWS FROM(generate_series(1,3)) WITH ORDINALITY
SELECT * FROM join_people p INNER JOIN join_links l ON p.id = l.person_id
SELECT count(*) AS count FROM join_people
SELECT count(*) FROM join_people HAVING count(*) > $1
SELECT domain_numbers, domain_array FROM native_items WHERE domain_numbers = $1 AND domain_array = $2
SELECT id FROM native_items WHERE id = ANY($1)
SELECT id FROM native_items WHERE id = ANY($1) AND id >= ALL($2)
SELECT id FROM people WHERE NOT active = $1 OR id >= $2 AND name ILIKE $3 ORDER BY id LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
SELECT id FROM people WHERE id = $1
SELECT id FROM people WHERE id IN ($1, $2)
SELECT id FROM people WHERE name = $1
SELECT mood, small_value, nested_value, required_value FROM native_items WHERE mood = $1 AND small_value = $2 AND nested_value = $3
SELECT moods FROM native_items WHERE moods = $1

SELECT name FROM people
WHERE (id = $1 AND id = $2) ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT name FROM people WHERE id = $1
SELECT note FROM people WHERE note = $1
SELECT p.* FROM join_people p JOIN join_links l ON p.id = l.person_id
SELECT p.*, l.* FROM join_people p JOIN join_links l ON p.id = l.person_id
SELECT p.id AS identifier, p.name FROM public.people AS p
SELECT p.id AS identifier, p.name, l.label FROM join_people p JOIN join_links l ON p.id = l.person_id
SELECT p.id FROM join_people p JOIN join_links l ON p.id = l.person_id
SELECT p.id FROM join_people p JOIN join_links l ON p.id = l.person_id AND l.id = $1
SELECT p.id FROM join_people p JOIN join_links l ON p.id = l.person_id AND l.label = $1 WHERE p.name = $2 ORDER BY l.id LIMIT $3
SELECT p.id, l.label FROM join_people p JOIN join_links l ON p.id = l.person_id
SELECT row_number() OVER() AS position FROM join_people
SELECT small_value, id, big_value FROM people
UPDATE ppx_items AS i SET note = $1, name = $2 WHERE (i.id = $3) RETURNING i.id, i.note
UPDATE ppx_items SET note = $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING note
UPDATE ppx_items SET revision = DEFAULT RETURNING id
